title: Exact abelian section rows imply bounded-below total descent
statement: Let J be a strictly bounded-below cochain complex of abelian sheaves on the pro-etale site of X and U a simplicial object over W. If the augmented section row [def-weil-pbc-proetale-abelian-hypercover-augmentation] of every term J^n is a quasi-isomorphism, then the augmentation from the section complex J(W) to its abelian hypercover total [def-weil-pbc-proetale-abelian-hypercover-total] is a quasi-isomorphism.

source.place: Tags 09A2 and 0946; Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach, Constructible sheaves, Lemma 5.3(1)

proof.text: Use restriction as the augmentation into the zeroth simplicial column. The bicomplex is zero in negative simplicial degrees and below a coefficient lower bound. Identify its transposed single-column maps with the hypothesized augmented rows, then apply bounded-below row augmentation comparison.
